## Chapter Eighteen

Downsizing



As evening drew close and the sun settled just below the trees Lucas tightened his coat against the cold winter wind as snow sprouted lightly from the sky, threatening to get heavier as the night wore on. He stood surveying the scenery of the unfamiliar area. They had reached “babel” an hour ago and some of the men were unpacking the contents of the big box truck into the new building. The old dilapidated building had once housed a US mail processing hub.

The area surrounding it had been a bustling suburb of DC having grown from farmlands as more houses were needed during the population boom before the plague. Now the area was practically abandoned the population having either died seventy years before or moved closer to the city. Leaving the once expensive small city to rot as nature took back what man had once built. On one side across the street stood a long abandoned office building, ivy and other creeper vines had retaken most of the outside , the windows having long since been removed or smashed and the interior open to elements even in the dim light Lucas could see the collapsed ceiling and hanging wires. The other side of the street held a bit of a curiosity. It was an Old High School that part of the building was still being used, it wasn’t well maintained and probably had a class of only twentyfive or so students, in the rear he could make out a large part of the building which at some point had collapsed, and the bleacher areas on the other side had been stolen for scrap metal, leaving a partial brick back wall and then a view of a field that had not been maintained in many many decades. The sign was what he had spent the most time staring at, trying to make out the name of the old school, S n ca was all the old sign still read.

Giving up, his gaze continued to the rubble of what had once been an apartment complex next to this large facility. At first glance he had thought a bomb had dropped onto it, but closer inspection he could see the partial scaffolding built from old boards and the tool marks from where bricks, boards and metal were pried from the building to use elsewhere or sold.

He had noticed that in a lot of these once upscale areas, when the population had abandoned them and the buildings were no longer lived in, people came like vultures on carrion to salvage what they could, to fix their own houses or businesses. The more that was taken the more to the elements the remainder was exposed until you got what he was looking at now, a sad foundation of rubble.

“You okay?” Came a feminine voice from behind and he turned to see Emma and Victoria approaching from the building, both in large black coats and gloves. Lucas nodded to them and then turned back to looking over the landscape before the last of the light disappeared “Im okay, was just lost in thought” he said without turning back towards them. The women came to stand on either side of Lucas “Sally says people are starting to come in and he needs help handing out blankets and food as we process them” Emma said looking at Lucas trying to decipher the look on his face, and finally giving up. With a sigh he nodded and followed the girls back into the building. The main floor of the old processing plant was chaotic as people milled about waiting in an unofficial line to talk to Sally and then get supplies to settle in until they could be organized to move.



Most had questions about why they were brought in and once explained their faces went white, realizing the impact of his words and the loss of their comrades, he kept the revelation or suspicion, depending on who you asked of Dysons supposed role in things. His name carried weight and hope even from prison, that was something they needed desperately.



“I meant to ask” Lucas said quietly to Victoria “Any progress on that video file. A frown appeared on her face and she shook her head. “There is something there, but it’s not something that I can take apart, I am working on it and I am sure I will get it, but whoever worked on that file, was good, I mean scary good. It took me a full day before I finally found something that wasn’t perfect.” She said with a grudging respect for the forger.



“Is it enough to know that someone put Dyson in that video?” he asked hopefully and then the hope dying quickly when she shook her head. “No, I mean I am assuming the random noise I am seeing on the pixel level of that video is someone masking the image, but until I finish processing it, it’s still an assumption” she finished.

They approached Sally who smiled and put them to work handing out blankets. Lucas was grateful for the easy work, it got him out of his own head and right now, that was not a place he wanted to be. So he filled the next few hours talking and helping those who wandered in from hearing the message, with their few possessions gathered under there arm, they looked to their small group for protection and guidance, these people were the heroes, those who could not stand by and allow the government to take advantage to resist, to try and bring back a democracy which over the decades had become only a dream. He felt humbled by the presence of these amazing people.

After a while Lucas was pulled from his thoughts as a hand fell on his shoulder, he turned to find Sally looking at him, the look on his face was dire and he motioned for him to follow. He didn’t like the look on his friends face but kept quiet as they navigated through the crowd, Sally putting on a smile and nodding to everyone they passed.

They made their way towards the rear of the room where everyone Victoria and Emma were waiting. “I just got word that Rolle’s location might be compromised, I am taking Victoria and Emma to go get him, I need you to stay and help me here, now before you argue, these people are exposed and we need every able bodied soldier here to ensure they stay safe” Sally said heading off the slew of protests that were bubbling up in Lucas’s mind. He calmed down on his mouth before he said something stupid, arguing with Sally when his mind was made up would just be a waste of time.

All three nodded and Victoria, Emma and Sally rushed out the door while Lucas stood there, feeling impudent and useless. His friend could be in trouble and he was stuck there. He could see Chow setting up cots and people milling about. He was worried about Rolle and also worried about Job, no one had seen him, and thought Sally said he did that from time to time, he always managed to return. But he could use him now, they were short on people. He circled the room a few times ensuring everyone had eaten and were settling okay. He got the same questions each time “What was going on, Are we safe, when do we leave” Lucas had no answers for them and felt even worse.

As he was taking his third pass around the room another hand fell on his shoulder and he turned to find a very nervous Job standing behind him “Jesus man where have you been” he asked hugging the other man who limply returned the gesture. “Had some things to do” he said, not making eye contact and looking around the room at all of the people. “Is everyone here?” he asked before Lucas could ask if he was okay. “Yeah” he said “Whats wrong Job?” he asked. Job just continued to look around the room, at first Lucas thought he had not heard him, but then he turned his haunted look focused on his young friend. “We need to talk, outside” he said and then pushed past Lucas.

Lucas was confused, something was wrong, where the hell had Job been and why did he look like hell. He thought to himself. Job continued a little way from the building and stood looking out into the night, facing away from Lucas. Something didn’t seem right Lucas thought as he too scanned the area, looking for anything out of place, Job looked wrong all wrong. “Hey kid, this is tough, and you have to know, it isn’t personal, but this is how I prove my loyalty, this is my ticket back in” Job said, his voice thick with emotion his head lowered as he continued to face away from Lucas. “What the hell are you talking about Job? what have you done?” Lucas asked, not knowing if he wanted to hear the answer.

Job turned, Lucas could see the tears in his eyes and in his hands was a pistol. Lucas took a step back “Don’t move kid” he said simply, no heat in his voice, just resignation. “Job what the fuck is going on?” He said panicked. Before Job could answer a cacophony of gunfire opened up from inside the building followed by screams and more gunfire, Lucas whirled around and stared towards the windows where flashes and shadows was all he could see. But the screams seared their memory in his mind as the gun fire continued and then there was silence. What the hell was going on Lucas thought trying to find some semblance of sanity and finding none. He slowly turned to face Job. “What did you do?” he asked in a whisper. His friend just shrugged. “I got tired, I was tired of living hand to mouth, of running, of Dysons continued bullshit, I was just tired, and then someone approached me, told me I could be a part of the higher echelon, that I would’nt have to worry about my future or money, so I took it, I took it and never looked back” he said. Again, that same resigned voice, there was no anger or sorrow, just defeat. “You mother fucker” Lucas said stepping towards the man he thought was his friend and Job fired.

Lucas lay there as his world went black, Job knelt down grabbing his face and pulling it so he could look into Jobs eyes “It’s nothing personal” he said and then shot Lucas twice more.
